comparisons.peer_summary: Sales teams possess technical expertise and are supported by application engineers and solution architects who provide pre-sales assistance for system design optimization and model fine-tuning, which is believed to be key to improving time-to-market and customer satisfaction.
comparisons.comparison: Both Broadcom and NVIDIA highlight the critical role of pre-sales technical support and expertise in driving customer success and product adoption. Broadcom states that its ValueOps solution improves 'time to value' by aligning teams, while NVIDIA explicitly states that the depth of its design support is key to improving 'time-to-market' and maintaining customer satisfaction by helping partners optimize hardware and software infrastructure.

sentences.text: • ValueOps: This solution delivers value stream management capabilities that enable customers to schedule, track, and manage work throughout its lifecycle from investment planning to execution. It aligns business and development teams across the enterprise, increasing transparency, reducing inefficiencies, and improving time to value.

We believe that the depth and quality of our design support are key to improving our partner network's time-to-market, maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction, and fostering relationships that encourage our end customers and partner network to use the next generation of our products within each platform.
